description: Golden dataset v2, authored against the Postgres corpus of 1844 documents on Data Dragon patch 16.14.1. Every expected_doc_key is verified to resolve. scoring selects the metric: retrieval questions score hit rate and MRR, refusal questions score only whether the answer declined, limitation questions are known-unanswerable in v1 and excluded from both headline figures.
